text:
arjun: Thanks for the great all-hands coverage. Dropping the RCA link + a compact owner list for follow-ups so we can track closure outside the meeting.

arjun: RCA: https://internal.redwood.ai/rca/INC-2026-1804 (root cause summary: stale routing preference + unexpected failover to warm path; timeline + artifacts in doc).

maeve: question  are the temporary rate caps still live? any expected customer impact?
arjun: caps are in place for all prod regions; small customer-facing degradation noticed for bursts, but overall stability improved. ops is monitoring.

kyle: i'll own the permanent fix on the route-applier (small refactor + unit tests). ETA: 4 business days.

ops-bot: deploy-note: pref-cap-applied -> success; monitor-job started -> ok. (automated)

lina: i'll take post-deploy verification: latency tail, error rate, and cache-hit checks. will post 2h and 24h notes.

noah: comms: do we want the public status page updated now or after full code fix? leadership prefers after global validation.
tara: i'll draft cautious wording to stage: "Mitigation applied; code fix and validations underway; customers monitored."

benji: i'll add a CI integration that simulates the failover pattern so we don't regress. ETA: EOW.

kyle: accepted: route-applier fix -> kyle (due: 2026-04-14).
lina: accepted: post-deploy verification -> lina (first check due: 2026-04-10).

benji: accepted: CI reproducer -> benji (due: 2026-04-09).

maeve: tiny ask  can the model-onboarding checklist include a quick routing sanity test? prevents future surprises.
arjun: yes, add to onboarding; @maeve can you draft a short test case and ping devex?

maeve: will do and link the checklist item back to the tracker.
tara: status blurb draft posted to tracker for review. will hold publish until lina confirms 24h green.

ops-bot: permission-log: grant-request for spill-logs-dashboard -> approved for kyle.

lina: started first verification run; 2h note will be in tracker.

arjun: ACTIONS (mirrored to tracker):
- kyle: route-applier code fix + unit/integration tests (owner: kyle; due: 2026-04-14)
- benji: CI reproducer for spillover failover (owner: benji; due: 2026-04-09)
- lina: post-deploy verification (2h & 24h checks) (owner: lina; first note due: 2026-04-10)
- maeve: routing sanity test for model-onboarding checklist (owner: maeve; due: 2026-04-12)
- tara: draft status page blurb; publish after 24h validation (owner: tara; pending)

arjun: react when you pick up an item so I can mark progress in the tracker. call out blockers here.

kyle: started the refactor branch now. ping if you need a review.

lina: 2h verification: tail latency stable, error-rate nominal (0.08% 5m avg). posting details to tracker.

maeve: onboarding test drafted and pushed to docs; pinged devex for review.

tara: will hold publish until lina's 24h signoff. thanks team. :raised_hands:
